answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 40468 Country: India Title: Can a husband and wife perform salah by making jamah with the husband doing imamah Question: Can a husband and wife perform salah by making jamah with the husband doing imamah? Answer ID: 40468 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1244/779/L=1433) Yes, husband and wife can offer salah in Jamah, but the wife shall stand behind her husband not beside him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
